questions.text: Which one of the following is the recurrence equation for the worst case time complexity of the Quicksort algorithm for sorting n ( [latex]\geq[/latex]2) numbers? In the recurrence equations given in the options below, c is a constant.
questions.solution:
Worst case: the pivot is the smallest/largest each time, so the partition sizes are n[latex]-[/latex]1 and 1, plus linear partitioning work.

T(n) = T(n [latex]-[/latex] 1) + T(1) + cn

Answer: T(n) = T(n-1) + T(1) + cn

questions.solution:
Checking each statement:
- Maximum: complete tree with levels 0 to 5 = [latex]2^6-1=63[/latex] nodes
- Minimum: a single path of 5 edges = 6 nodes

Answer: 63 and 6
